title: Nearly drowning in the Missouri River; a friend drowns
summary: After being expelled for lateness he swam with the boys, almost drowned crossing to the island, and a quartet friend drowned.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: So, finally, when I got out of school... I didn't get out. They kicked me out for bein' late all the time. I didn't show up at all. I'd go fishin'. Me and a bunch of the boys go down by the river and go swimmin', and a couple of us got drown'd down there. So that took kinda the sails outa my windpipe there. I didn't want to wind up like that... 'cause I couldn't swim that good but I had a lot of nerve. I would get out there with the rest of them that could swim. I follow them.

So, one day we swimmin' so we...the water wasn't too deep, and the place where we's at had a big island out in the middle of it, so the kids say, "We gonna swim out to the island." Big, old muddy river--the Missouri River. So, he say, "If you don' go, you're a...you're a scaredy cat. You can't be with the bunch if you don't come on in with us."

So I practically walked over there. I didn't swim 'cause I couldn't swim that good. It wasn't that deep right there. So we went over, and we got over on the island, and everybody decided after we got over there...played around on the island awhile, and we decided to go back. Well, they went back on the other side. Was deep over there. So, I tried, and my little swimmin' didn't do so good, so I like to got drown'd. So one of the kids got me out. An' I ain't gonna try that no more. I got scared...scared to go in the river again...'cause a coupla my friends got drown'd. Good little friend of mine, was a real tight buddy, used to sing in the quartet with us. He got drown'd. He went down and died down in the river and come up under a big boat, and he couldn't hold his wind long enough to get out from under it, so they...he got drown'd, and they fish around in the river there for him a couple of days, and they finally found him.
